name: David Russell
residence: Platte County (Wheatland; Cowboy State Daily, citing his official county biography)
occupation: Former Platte County sheriff (elected 2022; resignation accepted August 2025, effective Sept. 30, 2025). Cowboy State Daily, citing his official county biography, reported that his law-enforcement career started at the Platte County Sheriff's Office in 2012 and that he was also a Wyoming park ranger for six seasons.
education: Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, Colorado Technical University; master's degree, University of San Diego (Cowboy State Daily, citing his official county biography)
prior_offices: Platte County Sheriff's Office (from 2012, as reported by Cowboy State Daily citing his official biography); Wyoming park ranger (six seasons, same report); Platte County sheriff (elected 2022; resigned effective Sept. 30, 2025)
background: David Russell served as Platte County sheriff after winning the November 2022 general election. Cowboy State Daily reported on August 26, 2025, that the commission, with Chairman Steve Shockley and Commissioner Jeb Baker voting, accepted his resignation effective September 30, 2025, and that a reason was not given to the public at that meeting. The same report, citing his official county biography, said he grew up in Wheatland, started at the sheriff's office in 2012, served as a Wyoming park ranger for six seasons, earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Colorado Technical University, and earned a master's degree from the University of San Diego. Anthony "Tony" Krotz was later appointed sheriff.
